description: Turns a hue, a saturation and a value into red, green and blue voltages, a channel at a time

params.text: Scales the hue input before the hue offset is added, -1 to 1; at 1 a 10V ramp covers one full turn of the colour wheel
Sets the hue on its own while nothing is patched to the hue jack, and is added to that jack when something is; 0 to 1 covers one turn of the colour wheel
Scales the saturation input before the saturation offset is added, -1 to 1
Sets the saturation on its own while nothing is patched to the saturation jack, and is added to that jack when something is; 0 gives grey and 1 gives full colour
Scales the value input before the value offset is added, -1 to 1
Sets the brightness on its own while nothing is patched to the value jack, and is added to that jack when something is; 0 gives black and 1 gives full brightness

inputs.text: Sets the hue through the hue scale and offset trimpots, 0V to 10V for one turn of the colour wheel; the result is wrapped, so it never runs off the end
Sets the saturation through the saturation scale and offset trimpots, 0V to 10V for none to full
Sets the brightness through the value scale and offset trimpots, 0V to 10V for black to full

outputs.text: The red of the resulting colour, 0V for none and 10V for full
The green of the resulting colour, 0V for none and 10V for full
The blue of the resulting colour, 0V for none and 10V for full

notes: the saturation and value scale trimpots come up at -1 and their offsets at 1, so 0V to 10V on either jack runs the colour from full towards none; scale 1 and offset 0 reverse that
the lamp shows the colour the first channel is making, which with nothing patched is the colour the three offset trimpots set between them

inputs.0:
0 to 10V · continuous · polyphonic

unpatched it reads the hue offset trimpot.
inputs.1:
0 to 10V · continuous · polyphonic

unpatched it reads the saturation offset trimpot.
inputs.2:
0 to 10V · continuous · polyphonic

unpatched it reads the value offset trimpot.
